g.text: Proposed curriculum hierarchy — Informatics Principles Foundations
Digital Design Principles and Computer Architecture
informatics_and_computing_context — Informatics, ICT, computer history, software categories, and the role and use of computing systems.
computational_problem_solving — Translating small problems into computational solutions through systematic algorithm design.
information_representation — Binary and other representations of numeric and non-numeric information in computers.
algorithm_notation — Representation of algorithms with pseudocode, flow diagrams, and comparable notations.
computer_system_overview — Introductory organization of hardware, software, memory, processors, and their interactions.
imperative_programming — Core imperative, structured, and modular program construction across introductory languages.
control_flow_and_iteration — Sequence, selection, loops, and iterative solution techniques.
functions_parameters_and_recursion — Functions, procedures, scope, parameter passing, activation behavior, and recursion.
primitive_and_aggregate_data — Primitive values, strings, records or structures, arrays, matrices, and language-level data types.
program_io — Console and file input/output in introductory programming environments.
program_development_tools — Editors, compilers, interpreters, debuggers, command-line environments, and basic development workflow.
abstract_data_types — Specification and implementation of reusable abstract data types.
linear_and_linked_structures — Arrays, lists, linked representations, and algorithms over linear collections.
stacks_queues_and_trees — Construction and use of stacks, queues, and tree structures.
memory_management_and_pointers — Addresses, pointers, dynamic allocation, memory organization, and memory-leak concerns.
searching_sorting_and_complexity — Searching, ordering, sorting, numerical algorithm analysis, and introductory complexity reasoning.
array_matrix_computing — Vector, array, and matrix operations in scientific programming environments.
numerical_methods — Numerical algorithms for approximation, roots, derivatives, integrals, and related computations.
scientific_programming_workflows — Use of MATLAB/Octave, Python, R, or C++ for numerical and scientific problem solving.
scientific_data_formats_and_export — Reading scientific catalogs and formats and exporting results to CSV or spreadsheets.
statistical_data_analysis — Sample selection, correlations, random values, and statistical data modeling.
visualization_and_packages — Graphics, scientific modules, and package-based analytical workflows.
boolean_logic — Boolean algebra, expressions, functions, gates, and circuit representations.
combinational_circuit_design — Analysis and synthesis of combinational logic networks.
finite_state_models — Finite-state machines for representing sequential system behavior.
sequential_circuit_design — Analysis and synthesis of synchronous and asynchronous sequential networks.
instruction_set_and_assembly — Machine languages, instruction-set architectures, assembly programming, and RISC/CISC styles.
processor_organization — CPU structure, Von Neumann organization, execution models, and processor implementations such as DLX.
memory_io_and_interrupts — Memory devices, addressing, input/output addressing, and interrupts.
computer_performance_and_parallelism — Performance measurement, architectural performance effects, and parallel architectures.
microprocessor_system_design — Design and organization of simple microprocessor-based systems.
operating_systems — Operating systems as the software layer managing computer operation and resources.
computer_networking_and_internet — Networking concepts, Internet services, communication protocols, the web, and DNS.
data_security — Introductory principles concerning the security of stored and communicated data.
unix_and_system_tools — Unix command-line use and system-oriented programming environments and tools.
language_syntax_semantics_and_runtime — Language history, EBNF syntax, semantics, execution models, and run-time activation records.
object_oriented_programming — Classes, inheritance, polymorphism, templates or typing mechanisms, and object-oriented program design.
functional_programming — Functional programming, functions as abstractions, and lambda-calculus foundations.
logic_programming — Declarative logic programming and implementation with Prolog.
multiparadigm_integration — Combination and integration of imperative, object-oriented, functional, and logic-programming approaches.
development_processes_and_agile — Program-development phases, software methodologies, agile processes, and Scrum.
testing_and_quality — Unit testing, test-driven development, agile testing, clean code, and software-quality practices.
refactoring_and_design_patterns — Refactoring and the use of design and architectural patterns to improve software structure.
continuous_delivery_and_documentation — Continuous integration, continuous delivery, and project documentation practices.
relational_data_model_and_algebra — Relations, tuples, attributes, schemas, databases, and relational-algebra operations.
sql_definition_manipulation_and_queries — SQL schema definition, data modification, joins, subqueries, grouping, aggregation, and set operations.
database_integrity_views_and_access — Keys, referential integrity, views, and management of database access privileges.
quantum_mathematical_foundations — Linear algebra, complex Hilbert spaces, and mathematical foundations for quantum computation.
qubits_and_quantum_circuits — Mathematical representation of qubits and quantum circuits as computational models.
quantum_programming_models — Quantum programming and graphical languages used to express quantum circuits.
quantum_algorithms_and_complexity — Quantum algorithms such as Deutsch, Bernstein-Vazirani, Simon, Grover, and Shor, with quantum complexity concepts.
quantum_error_correction — Principles and methods for detecting and correcting errors in quantum computation.
quantum_protocols_and_cryptography — Quantum protocols, advanced applications, and quantum cryptography.
